questiontext.text:
For each circle on the earth's surface, choose whether it is a great circle, a small circle or half of a great circle.

Navigation: great and small circles

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.7 (a) / Essential 2.3 (a): Classify circles on the earth as great circles, small circles or half of a great circle.

Core and Essential

This question is original to this project.
